description: This Java source file defines the class LifoSet, a custom collection that combines behaviors of a stack and a set, using a LinkedList internally to maintain order and provide stack operations along with set semantics (no duplicates). It includes methods for adding, popping, peeking, and capacity management, and implements the AbstractSet interface.

classes.name: LifoSet
classes.description: A set-like collection with LIFO (stack) semantics, backed by a LinkedList, supporting capacity limits and typical set operations.

methods.name: LifoSet
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty LifoSet.

methods.name: LifoSet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set with a specified maximum capacity.

methods.name: setCapactity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity of the LifoSet.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the set.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the top of the set, maintaining max capacity and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the set elements.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the set is empty.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an element onto the stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top element of the stack; throws EmptyStackException if empty.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the top element without removing it; throws EmptyStackException if empty.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns the 1-based position from the top of the stack for a given item, or -1 if not found.
